readme.text:
# Bayonetta Archipelago Randomizer

A custom Archipelago (https://archipelago.gg) client for **Bayonetta 1 (PC)**.
It integrates with **BayoHook** (a `dinput8.dll` proxy) to send and receive
location checks and items in real time during a multiworld randomizer run, as well as real-time **P2P Co-op multiplayer** player syncing.

Everything installs with one file: the **Bayonetta Archipelago Launcher** (`BayonettaArchipelago.exe`).

---

## Features

### Bayonetta Archipelago Launcher
- **One-Click Install:** Finds your Bayonetta and Archipelago folders automatically, then installs, updates or uninstalls the mod. Any `dinput8.dll` you had before is backed up and restored on uninstall.
- **APWorld Install:** Puts `bayonetta.apworld` into Archipelago's `custom_worlds` folder for you.
- **Connection Settings:** Enter your server, port, slot name and password once, and optionally connect automatically when the game starts. No typing in-game.
- **Auto-Updater:** Checks GitHub for new releases and updates itself and the mod with one click.
- **Quick Links:** Launch the game, open the game folder or logs, open the Archipelago Launcher, and report a bug.

### Native Title Screen Integration
- The title menu's LEADERBOARDS entry is replaced by **ARCHIPELAGO**, in the game's own font, highlight and fire effect. Selecting it opens and closes the Archipelago settings.
- A custom title logo: *Bayonetta — Archipelago — Made by Boi*, with the Archipelago logo inside the O.
- The old leaderboard screen is disabled.

### Real-Time Steam Co-op (Experimental)
- **P2P Player Syncing:** Connect directly with another player over Steam networking to see each other in real-time within the game world.
- **Host & Join Rooms:** Easily create or join a co-op room via 64-bit Room IDs directly inside the BayoHook UI.
- **Live Puppet Telemetry:** Syncs 3D coordinates (X, Y, Z), character rotation, move IDs, move parts, and animation frames frame-by-frame.

### Location Checks
- All 21 Alfheim Portals
- 18 Chapters (Prologue + I–XVI + Requiem completion checks)
- All Verses (per-chapter, over 200 locations)
- 45 Treasure Chests (Umbran Resting Places)
- 18 Umbran Tears of Blood (Normal difficulty, opt-in)
- Optional Verse Rank bonus locations (medal-based, configurable grade, with an optional **maximum medal** so nobody gets BK'd waiting on a Platinum)
- All Weapons (via LP turn-in / instant grant detection at the Gates of Hell)
- All Accessories (shop purchase checks with dynamic shop transition handling)
- All Techniques (shop purchase checks with edge-triggering detection)
- Consumables, crafting ingredients, and Halos (12 denominations from 137 to 200,000)

### Goal Options (set in YAML)
- **All Chapters** — Complete all 18 chapters (Prologue + I–XVI + Requiem)
- **Chapter Count** — Complete a set number of chapters (Requiem can be one of them)
- **Boss Rush** — Complete only the boss chapters (IV, VII, XI, XIII, XIV, XVI) + Requiem
- **Chapter Count (No Requiem)** — Complete X chapters, Requiem not required
- **MacGuffin Hunt** — Collect enough Eyes of the World Fragments from the item pool

### Traps (15)
Junk checks can bite back. The full trap pool:

- **Pickpocket** — Steals up to 10,000 Halos.
- **Bloodletting** — Halves your current HP (never kills).
- **Fragile Witch** — Sets you to 1 HP. Don't get hit.
- **Magic Drain** — Empties your magic gauge.
- **Amnesia** — Forgets a random technique you own for 30 seconds, then gives it back.
- **Sticky Fingers** — Swipes up to 3 of one random consumable.
- **Squish** — Bayonetta gets squished for 20 seconds (makes you slippery and heavy).
- **Squash** — Bayonetta gets flattened for 3 seconds (as if Golem squashed you).
- **Angel Ambush** — Three random rank-and-file angels spawn on you.
- **Grace & Glory** — The claw duo joins your fight.
- **Nemesis** — Enemy Jeanne hunts you down.
- **Alfheim Curse** — You can only survive three more hits before being reduced to 1 HP.
- **Berserk** — Every active enemy instantly becomes enraged.
- **Gracious & Glorious** — The upgraded claw duo joins the fight. Faster, meaner, and definitely not Grace & Glory.
- **Fairness & Fearless** — Spawns everyone's favorite Fire and Lightning Duo!

A `trap_percentage` YAML option controls how much of the filler pool becomes traps.

### Multiplayer Link Protocols
- **Death Link** — Shared death. When they die, you die. When you die, they die.
- **Damage Link** — Shared pain. Damage taken is partially sent to other players. Never lethal alone.
- **Trap Link** — Shared traps. Your traps fire on others, theirs fire on you.
- **Ring Link** — Shared Halos. Halos you collect become rings for others (1 ring = 50 Halos). Shop purchases excluded.

### Client Features
- **Status Card** — The top of the Archipelago tab shows your connection, goal progress, a checks bar with how many are in logic, and lock badges for Witch Time, Punch, Kick, Torture and Angel Arms.
- **Halo Shop (Black Market)** — Spend late-game Halos on a random filler check or a guaranteed progression check from your own world.
- **On-Screen Notifications** — Color-coded popups for items, checks, deaths, hints, and completions. Always visible, no key press needed.
- **Shop Auto-Scouting** — Entering the Gates of Hell automatically reveals what items are at each shop location without using hint points.
- **Edge-Triggered Shop Checks** — Real-time purchase detection for Techniques and Alt Weapons so location checks send instantly upon purchase.
- **Dynamic LP-to-Weapon Mapping** — Automatically links LP item IDs to corresponding weapon shop check locations to ensure zero missed location checks on item receipt.
- **Source-Level Combat Filtering** — Locked combat categories (Punches, Kicks, Torture Attacks, Angel Arms, Double Jump) are safely blocked at the engine level without crashing mid-combo. Captures advanced composite combo strings (e.g., PPKP) while leaving standard opener punches available. Locks are lifted in boss QTE arenas so dodge prompts can't softlock you.
- **Chapter-Blocking Enforcement** — Only AP-unlocked chapters appear in the Chapter Select menu.
- **Save-Safe Connecting** — You can only connect once a save file is loaded, so items and Halos are never synced into an empty game.
- **Crash Diagnostics & Organized Logs** — Automatically generates minidump (`.dmp`) files on crashes and organizes all session logs into a dedicated `Archipelago Logs/` folder next to `Bayonetta.exe`.
- **Built-in Tracker** — Grouped by chapter with natural sort, real location names, live progress updates, and a "GO Mode" indicator when you're one step from victory.
- **Website-Style Colored Console** — Items colored by classification, players tinted, per-category filtering, and detailed check skipping reasons.
- **In-Game Chat & Hint Commands** — Full Archipelago chat and hint system from the console tab.
- **Session Persistence** — Disconnect and reconnect without losing progress. Completed checks, granted items, and unlocked chapters survive disconnects.

---

## Roadmap

### Done
- AP client core (connect, slot auth, items, checks, chat, hints, tracker UI)
- Steamworks P2P Co-op integration (Lobby creation/joining, telemetry packet sync, player puppet rendering)
- On-screen notification system with color-coded events
- Shop auto-scouting (LocationScouts without hint points)
- Dynamic LP-to-Weapon location mapping for guaranteed check sending
- Edge-triggered shop check detection for Techniques and Alt Weapons
- Chapter unlocks as items (+ in-game chapter blocking hook)
- Chapter completion locations
- Verse completion locations
- Alfheim locations
- Treasure Chest locations (all 45 mapped and polling)
- Umbran Tears of Blood locations (18 Normal mapped and polling)
- Verse Rank (medal) bonus locations with configurable grade target and maximum medal
- Weapons as items (grant + ownership bits)
- LP locations (instant grant + check sending)
- Techniques as items (incl. Panther/Crow/Bat Within, purchase detection)
- Accessories as items (+ purchase locations)
- Consumables, Halos, Witch Heart & Moon Pearl fragments as items
- Max HP/MP scaling with received fragments
- DeathLink, Damage Link, Trap Link, Ring Link
- 15 trap items (health, magic, amnesia, consumable theft, enemy spawns, curses, squash)
- MacGuffin Hunt goal (Eyes of the World Fragments)
- Multiple goal options (All Chapters, Chapter Count, Boss Rush, No Requiem, MacGuffin)
- GO Mode indicator in tracker
- Session persistence across disconnects
- Website-style colored console with per-category filtering & explicit check skip messaging
- Weapon shop logic (Golden LP gating)
- Save-flag memory layout reverse engineered (per-chapter flag lanes, static addresses)
- In-DLL tooling for flag discovery (guard-page access tracer + bit-flip logger, ChestMapper, Rank Finder)
- Debug toggles for isolating system issues (for dev purposes)
- Witch Time as an unlockable item
- Source-level Move ID hook for safe punch/kick/torture/angel arm/double jump restrictions
- Advanced combo filtering (captures composite strings like PPKP while preserving basic opener punches)
- Unified Move ID hook resolving conflicts with BayoHook trainer features
- Shop transition state trick for Accessories & Techniques (allows shop checks for AP-granted items)
- Crash dump generator (`.dmp`) & organized `Archipelago Logs` directory
- Halo Shop (Black Market) for filler and progression checks
- Launcher with one-click install, connection settings and auto-updater
- Native ARCHIPELAGO title menu entry and custom title logo
- Redesigned overlay with status card

### In Progress
- Co-op expansion (Equipment, HP/MP sync, costume sync, enemy position/health sync)

### To Do
- Filter in-game tracker to show only "in logic" checks
- Restore native Rodin LP turn-in shop menu without item auto-deletion
- Fix cosmetic Torture Attack prompt & magic consumption when locked
- Block Bat Within Witch Time while Evil Harvest Rosary is equipped
- Weapon switching as an unlockable item
- APWorld package polish (logic, options, location/item pools) for submission

### Not Planned / Stretch
- Randomized interactables (keys, levers, Temporal Witch Power Statues, etc.)
- Witch Heart / Moon Pearl World-pickup Locations

---

## Requirements

- **Bayonetta 1 (Steam version)**
- **[Visual C++ 2015-2022 redistributable (x86)](https://aka.ms/vc14/vc_redist.x86.exe)**
- An **Archipelago server** hosting a multiworld session.

`z.dll` is no longer needed as of v3.4.0. You can delete it from your game folder.

### Highly Recommended Additions
For the most stable, crash-free experience, we strongly recommend installing these alongside the AP mod:
- **[Bayonetta 4GB Patch](https://github.com/oceaniccamred/Bayonetta-4GB-Patched-EXE)** — Highly recommended to prevent out-of-memory crashes during extended modded runs.
- **[Bayonetta Essentials](https://gamebanana.com/mods/533310)** — Community performance and stability enhancements.

---

## Installation

### With the Launcher (recommended)
1. Download `BayonettaArchipelago.exe` from the [Releases](https://github.com/Boi-027/BayonettaArchipelago/releases) page and run it.
2. Check that it found your Bayonetta and Archipelago folders (use **Browse** if not).
3. Click **Install Mod** and **Install APWorld**.
4. Optional: fill in the **Connection** card and click **Save** so the game connects for you.
5. **Make sure to back up your saves before playing!**

When a new version is released, the launcher shows a gold **Update** button at the top. One click updates the launcher and the mod.

### Manual
1. Download `dinput8.dll` and `bayonetta.apworld` from the [Releases](https://github.com/Boi-027/BayonettaArchipelago/releases) page.
2. Place `dinput8.dll` into your Bayonetta game folder (the one containing `Bayonetta.exe`).
3. Place `bayonetta.apworld` into your Archipelago `custom_worlds` folder.

## APWorld Setup

1. Make sure `bayonetta.apworld` is in your Archipelago `custom_worlds` folder (the launcher does this for you).
2. Generate your multiworld as usual — the Bayonetta world will now be available.
3. All YAML options (include/exclude toggles, goal settings, link protocols, trap percentage, etc.) are fully functional.

**After updating, regenerate your seed.** Location IDs can change between versions, and v3.4.0 does not work with seeds generated on v3.3.0 or earlier.

## Playing

1. Start Bayonetta (or click **Launch Bayonetta** in the launcher).
2. **Load your save file first.** Connecting is only possible from inside a save, so your items and Halos sync into the right game.
3. If you saved your connection in the launcher with auto-connect on, you'll connect automatically. Otherwise, select **ARCHIPELAGO** on the title menu (or press **Delete** / **Insert**) to open the Archipelago settings, then connect from the **Connect** tab once your save is loaded.
4. Play! Checks fire automatically as you complete verses, chapters, open chests, collect tears, and make shop purchases.
5. Notifications appear in the top-left corner even when the menu is closed.
6. Visit the Gates of Hell to auto-scout shop items — no hint points needed!

### Co-op Setup
1. Both players launch the game and open the BayoHook UI (**Delete** key).
2. Go to the **Archipelago → Co-op** tab.
3. Player 1 clicks **Create Room**, then click **Copy ID** or **Refresh Lobbies (WIP DONT KNOW IF WORKS)** to share the 64-bit Room ID with Player 2 or join Lobby via Lobby Browser.
4. Player 2 pastes the ID into the **Room ID** box or joins via Lobby Browser and click **Join Room**.
5. Once connected enter the same Chapter then go to the **Extra** tab, then click on **Spawn Player 2** (TEMPORARY)
6. Once you are both are in the same Chapter and Verse you will get to see each other in real-time!


**NOTE: THIS IS VERY EARLY BETA, EXPECT LOTS OF BUGS AND STABILITY ISSUES!**

---

## Troubleshooting

- **Windows protected your PC (SmartScreen) when opening the launcher:** Click **More info → Run anyway**. The launcher isn't code-signed.
- **DLL doesn't load / Error `0xc0e90002`:**
  - Right-click `dinput8.dll`, select **Properties**, check the **Unblock** box at the bottom, and click Apply.
  - Add your Bayonetta game folder to your antivirus / Windows Defender exclusion list.
  - If using Windows 11, disable Smart App Control or S-Mode if untrusted DLLs are blocked.
- **Visual C++ Error:** Make sure you have the [Visual C++ 2015-2022 redistributable](https://aka.ms/vc14/vc_redist.x86.exe) installed.
- **The GUI isn't loading:** Try disabling overlays like GeForce Experience, RivaTuner, MSI Afterburner, ReShade, etc.
- **The Connect button is greyed out:** Load your save file first. Connecting from the title screen is disabled on purpose.
- **Newly acquired chapters don't appear:** Back out of the Chapter Select menu and re-enter it.
- **Game Crashes:** Check the `Archipelago Logs/` folder located next to `Bayonetta.exe` (the launcher's **Logs** button opens it). Send the `BayoHook_CrashDump.dmp` and `BayoHook_Archipelago.log` files when opening an issue.
- **"Unknown ID" in the tracker:** Your seed was generated with a different `.apworld` version. Regenerate it with the latest one, and if it still happens, open an Issue with the Unknown ID it shows.
- **Something else, or an idea for the project?** Open an Issue (or click **Report a bug** in the launcher) and let me know!

---

## Credits

- Built on top of [BayoHook](https://github.com/SSSiyan/BayoHook) by SSSiyan and others, used and redistributed with permission.
- Archipelago integration, P2P networking, and chapter-blocking by **Boi**.
- Huge thanks to the community for countless bug reports!

---

## AI Usage Disclosure

- The integration of Archipelago within BayoHook was built through hands-on reverse-engineering and manual C++ development.
- All core code — memory hooks, chapter-blocking, P2P telemetry sync, and debugging tools — was written by me through direct reverse-engineering and testing.
- I have used LLMs (Claude and DeepSeek) as a way to expand my ideas and for confirming small issues I've had:
  - Checking my math when working out memory addresses.
  - Making sure I understood how APWorld options are supposed to work.
  - Catching small mistakes that I really shouldn't have made.
- No AI-generated code was used in this project without being reviewed, tested in-game, and modified by me first.

## v3.4.0

### New Features
* **Bayonetta Archipelago Launcher:** A brand-new one-file installer, `BayonettaArchipelago.exe`. It finds your Bayonetta and Archipelago folders automatically, installs, updates or uninstalls the mod in one click (any `dinput8.dll` you had before is backed up and restored), installs the `.apworld` into `custom_worlds`, and launches the game.
  * **Connection settings:** Enter your server, port, slot name and password in the launcher, and tick "Connect automatically" so the game connects on its own when it starts. No more typing in-game.
  * **Auto-updater:** The launcher checks GitHub for new releases. When one is out, a gold **Update** button appears in the title bar. One click downloads the new launcher, restarts it and updates the mod in your game folder.
* **ARCHIPELAGO on the Title Screen:** The title menu's LEADERBOARDS entry is now **ARCHIPELAGO**, drawn in the game's own font, highlight and fire effect. Selecting it (Enter, click, or the A button) opens and closes the Archipelago settings, and the help line reads "Archipelago Settings". The old leaderboard screen is disabled entirely.
* **New Title Logo:** The Bayonetta logo now reads *Archipelago — Made by Boi*, with the Archipelago logo inside the O.
* **Verse Rank Max Medal (new option):** Choose the highest medal that has checks in the all-medals Verse Rank mode. For example, set it to Gold and only Bronze, Silver and Gold create checks, so nobody gets BK'd waiting on a Platinum.
* **Overlay Redesign:** A new dark violet, crimson and gold theme, plus a status card at the top of the Archipelago tab. It shows your connection, goal progress, a checks bar with how many are in logic, and lock badges for Witch Time, Punch, Kick, Torture and Angel Arms. The game stays fully playable while the overlay is open.

### Bug Fixes & Adjustments
* **Lost Halos When Connecting on the Title Screen:** Connecting before a save was loaded synced your items and Halos into an empty game, and they were lost once the save loaded. You can now only connect from inside a save file, and auto-connect waits until one is loaded.
* **Memory Fragments Goal Ending Early:** The client read the wrong setting for the required fragment count, so it always used 10 and could finish your goal instantly. "Requires Requiem" was also ignored. Both now follow your YAML.
* **Missed Verse Checks (III-13, VI-10, XII-3 and others):** Finished verses are no longer dropped when the medal screen is slow. Medals earned before visiting an in-level Gates of Hell are no longer wiped, and finishing a chapter now sends any verse checks that were missed.
* **Chapter XI Sending Chapter X Checks:** Chapter XI's boss arena was listed as part of Chapter X. It now sends the right checks, and about 20 missing stages were added to the stage list.
* **Medal Checks Crossing Chapters:** Fixed a location ID collision that sent some medals as other chapters' "Any Medal" checks.
* **Punch/Kick Locks:** Many punch moves were sorted as kicks, and some kicks as punches. Delay combos, Kulshedra's pull follow-ups and uppercut, Pillow Talk/Shuraba's charge slash and Full Moon, and Witch Twist now count as punches. Odette now correctly counts as a kick and no longer bypasses the kick lock.
* **Witch Time via Bat Within:** While Witch Time is locked, Witch Time triggered by Bat Within is now cancelled too. Witch Time also no longer stays locked while you're disconnected.
* **Boss QTE Softlocks:** The move and Witch Time locks are lifted in the Chapter IV, VII, XI, XVI and final Chapter XIV boss arenas, so dodge prompts can no longer softlock you.
* **Shop Fixes:**
  * Beast Within and Bullet Climax no longer disappear after visiting the shop.
  * All accessory checks are now restored when you reconnect, so items you already bought don't show up for sale again.
  * Purchases are detected more reliably.
  * Onyx Roses, Durga and Kilgore now stay on Rodin's shelf correctly.
  * Leaving an in-level Gates of Hell is now detected properly.
* **Golden LPs Off:** With Golden LPs disabled, the six shop weapon checks are sent as soon as you enter the shop, so the shop can't create a logic loop (the Kilgore loop report).

### Known Issues
* **Evil Harvest Rosary + Bat Within:** Bat Within can still trigger Witch Time while the Rosary is equipped.
* **Heel Slide:** If buying Heel Slide still doesn't send its check, please report it with your log.

### Todo
* **Co-op Enhancements:** Refine spectator scaling and sync timings for custom weapons during high-intensity co-op play.
* **Tracker Updates:** Work on making the item tracker only show items that are currently "in logic".

### Highly Recommended Additions
For the most stable and enjoyable experience, I strongly recommend downloading and installing these alongside the AP mod. It does not take much work to install and it will help with crashes and bugs the AP mod might have!
* **[Bayonetta 4GB Patch](https://github.com/oceaniccamred/Bayonetta-4GB-Patched-EXE)** (Highly recommended to prevent memory crashes)
* **[Bayonetta Essentials](https://gamebanana.com/mods/533310)**

### Downloads
- **`BayonettaArchipelago.exe`** (recommended): run it, then click **Install Mod** and **Install apworld**. It contains everything below.
- **Manual install:**
  - **`dinput8.dll`**: place it in your Bayonetta game folder (next to `Bayonetta.exe`).
  - **`bayonetta.apworld`**: place it in your Archipelago `custom_worlds` folder (replace the old one).
- `z.dll` is no longer needed. You can delete it from your game folder.

**⚠️ Regenerate your seeds:** Location IDs changed in this update, so seeds generated with v3.3.0 or earlier will not work with this version. Generate a new seed with the new `.apworld`.
